data.variant_note: Chosen as the constraint-cleanest of three generated candidates, then rebuilt programmatically for cleanliness; candidate rejection chain recorded in docs/ui/ui-direction.md session notes.

reuse: Rendered entirely from system fonts on a #050505 canvas, trimmed to content, saved as lossless WebP (2700x388, wide strip). Clean at any zoom. Used as the README.md header logo (display width 480).
